about: The warden's induction: the first tutorial, after the player wakes in the penal colony (docs/sandbox/TUTORIAL.md). Karl, 2026-11-11: woken up, shouted onto the crew bus, taken to the mine, the hand basics there, then the mine wall: shift a fallen rock with the physics gun, stand a Pit Prop on the face's footing with the attach tool, and fit a lamp on it. Show, don't tell (Karl): a step's text is one short line, the warden and the foreman carry the world, and the detail waits in the hint. One step at a time; each completes when the server sees its cue. {Action} in text shows the player's own key for that GameAction (Keybinds.cs). Text is ASCII. The player has no gun, no tools but bare hands and no backpack while it runs: "gives" names the tools a step hands over (kept for every later step; "backpack" hands over the backpack), and the end or a skip gives everything back. Cues: wait (seconds), look (radians turned, default 3), move (metres walked, default 6), sprint (seconds sprinting, default 1), jump, crouch, inventory, toolwheel, hold (a part in the hands), tool (that tool out: attach, linker, configure, grounddrill, physicsgun, hands...), place (a part fitted or set down), weld (two pieces joined with the attach tool), link (any routed link), power (a power cable), drill (the ground drill dug), assembler (an Assembler set or fed), configure (any part's settings), stow (a part put in the backpack), draw (a part taken out of it), carry (the physics gun took hold of something), bunk (lay in a Bunk), ride (the crew bus, a stand-in, from the "spot" stop to the other: colony or quarry; GameQuarry.cs). Optional per step: "speaker" (who says its line; default the file's), "target" (loose: a loose single part, the step's drops first; bunk) shows an orange marker on the nearest one and how far it is; "spot" (colony, quarry, wall: the mine face behind the quarry's works) marks a place the server knows instead; "hint" shows after "hintAfter" seconds on the step (default 35); "dropNote" (what the notice says when the drops land; default: the speaker sets them down), "drops" (part names, at most 4) are set down in front of the player as the step starts: a part for the hands must be an item (not physics-only). No inventory step: the Tab parts menu is off in survival away from a beacon. The machines, the bus home and the bunk are the quarry duty's (Story/Duties/Quarry.json), which follows on at the mine.
speaker: Warden Pettigrew

steps.title: On your feet
steps.warden: ON YOUR FEET, INMATE! Mine shift! The bus does not wait and neither do I!
steps.hint: Sweep the mouse left and right.

steps.title: Get on the bus
steps.text: {MoveForward} {MoveLeft} {MoveBack} {MoveRight} to walk, {Sprint} to run. Board the crew bus at the gate.
steps.warden: Out the gate and ON THE BUS! Sentence served is time worked, and you have worked none!
steps.hint: Follow the orange marker out of the gate. Stand next to the bus once it has stopped.

steps.title: The mine
steps.speaker: Foreman Grubb
steps.warden: Foreman Grubb. This is the face: it comes down about once a week. Hop, so I know the legs work.

steps.title: Pick up a lamp
steps.speaker: Foreman Grubb
steps.text: Look at a Lamp and press {Interact}.
steps.warden: Last shift dug in the dark. There was an inquiry. Pick up a lamp.
steps.hint: Walk up close to a Lamp (the orange marker), aim the crosshair at it and press {Interact}.

steps.title: Your backpack
steps.speaker: Foreman Grubb
steps.warden: Your pack. Whatever was in it is evidence now. Stow the lamp: you'll want your hands.
steps.hint: Lamp in your hands, press {Stow}. Its slot shows at the bottom of the screen.

steps.title: The physics gun
steps.speaker: Foreman Grubb
steps.text: Hold {ToolWheel}, flick to the physics gun, let go.
steps.warden: Hear that creaking? That's the face thinking about it. Get the physics gun out. You'll want it.
steps.hint: Hold {ToolWheel} until the wheel shows, move the mouse to the physics gun and let go.

steps.title: Shift the rubble
steps.speaker: Foreman Grubb
steps.text: Aim at the rock and hold {Fire}.
steps.warden: There she goes. Out of the way with it. Too heavy for hands: that's what the gun is for.
steps.hint: Keep {Fire} held to carry it; let go to drop it. The mouse wheel brings it closer or pushes it away.
steps.dropNote: A lump of the face comes down at your feet

steps.title: Pick up a pit prop
steps.speaker: Foreman Grubb
steps.text: Look at a Pit Prop and press {Interact}.
steps.warden: She'll come down again unless she's propped. Grab a prop.
steps.hint: Put the physics gun away first: hold {ToolWheel} and let go on your hands. Then walk up to a Pit Prop (the orange marker), aim at it and press {Interact}.

steps.title: The attach tool
steps.speaker: Foreman Grubb
steps.warden: Attach tool. It fixes what you're holding to what you're looking at.
steps.hint: Hold {ToolWheel}, flick to the attach tool and let go. {Weapon3} does it too.

steps.title: Shore up the wall
steps.speaker: Foreman Grubb
steps.text: Aim at the foot of the rock face and hold {Fire}.
steps.warden: Foot of the face, on the footing. Hold it there till it's fixed.
steps.hint: Stand close to the mine wall (the orange marker) with the prop in your hands and aim at the low footing under the rock. When the ghost shows, hold {Fire} until it is fitted.

steps.title: Light the face
steps.speaker: Foreman Grubb
steps.text: {DrawPack} the lamp, then aim at the prop and hold {Fire}.
steps.warden: Now the lamp, so the next shift can see what's about to land on them.
steps.hint: {DrawPack} takes the Lamp out of your pack. Attach tool out, aim at the prop until the ghost shows, then hold {Fire}. {RotateLeft} {RotateRight} turn the ghost.

steps.title: Wall's up
steps.speaker: Foreman Grubb
steps.text: You can move, carry and build. The Esc menu replays this.
steps.warden: It held, and nobody died. I'll put you down as skilled labour. Now, the works.
